gpt-4o-mini.title: Dragon Teeth

gpt-4o-mini.title: Case of Need
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: In this gripping medical thriller by Michael Crichton, a brilliant pathologist becomes embroiled in a complex murder investigation that challenges the ethics of medicine and the intricacies of human relationships. gpt-4o-mini.title: Pirate Latitudes
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: An exciting adventure set in the Caribbean during the 17th century, following a pirate's quest for treasure.

gemma2:9b.explanation: In Michael Crichton's gripping novel, a man with a history of violent seizures undergoes experimental brain surgery that leads to unforeseen consequences. The story delves into the ethical implications of technology and the fragility of the human mind.

gemma2:9b.title: The Lost World: A Jurassic Park Novel
gemma2:9b.explanation: A gripping sequel to Jurassic Park, exploring the dangers of unchecked scientific ambition.

gemma2:9b.title: Prey
gemma2:9b.explanation: A suspenseful thriller about nanotechnology gone wrong and its devastating consequences.
